sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

Heard Sri Jitendra Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra,
learned Brief Holder for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
273 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and Section 66C IT Act, Police Station Kotwali Fatehgarh, District Farrukhabad during pendency of the trial.
According to the FIR applicant and one another co-accused are public servant and they committed fraud and misappropriated more than Rs. 16 Lakhs from the salary of employees.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant did not commit any cheating or forgery and he did his job very sincerely and even if some mistake committed by him then he is ready to repay the amount.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 17.08.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is Senior Clerk Manoj Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154385470/
1 and he by playing fraud duped the public money of more then Rs. 16 Lakhs.

entities.text: Senior Clerk Manoj Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

FIR of the present case was lodged by Superintendent Engineer and as per allegation applicant was posted as Senior Assistant and his work was to prepare the salary of the employee and he by playing fraud misappropriated the money of more than Rs. 16 lakhs and no proper explanation was given by the applicant about the allegation made against the applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant during the course of argument submitted that applicant is ready to repay the amount and this fact clearly shows that applicant admitted his guilt.

Applicant being public servant committed offence under Section 409 IPC and duped the public money of more than Rs. 16 Lakhs, which is serious offence and he is in jail since 17.08.2022, therefore, considering the nature of allegation, severity of punishment, in my view, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.
